definitions: The process of shaping molten metal or other material by pouring it into a mould.
An object made by shaping molten metal or other material by pouring it into a mould.
The process of selecting actors for a play or film.
The act of throwing something, especially a fishing line or net.
examples: The factory specialises in iron casting.
The casting for the new series is complete.
A powerful casting of the net.
